rawContent: If we paused to consider all the white people who murdered black people in lynchings or personal assaults and then were never convicted or never even went to trial, we might start to scratch the surface how how profound this statement really is: #BlackLivesMatter

The deliberate obfuscation of the facts along with the devaluing of black lives means we may never know the exact number of people killed nor their identities. This is yet another reason we must still insist that #BlackLivesMatter
